requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall log all transactions along with their timestamps for compliance and audit purposes.
The system shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related saving account when necessary.
The ATM system shall ensure transactions are processed within 3 seconds.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption through efficient transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide clients with an option for electronic transaction records.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
